messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "procedure to improve blood flow to the heart"
set: ["procedure to improve blood flow to the heart", "blood to flow more easily", "blood flow", "allowing blood to flow more smoothly", "blood vessels offer less resistance to blood flow", "increases air flow to the lungs", "increasing the supply of blood to the heart", "procedure", "improve blood sugar control", "blood and oxygen flow to heart, brain, and other parts of body", "improve and maintain blood glucose levels", "improving urine flow", "heart problems leading to falls", "symptoms may not improve for up to 2 to 6 weeks", "coronary revascularization procedure", "many improve after the first few weeks as your body adjusts to the medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
